verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents AI drafting answers to inbound customer security questionnaires from the user's own controls or knowledge base. The closest item, Comply AI extracting answers from vendor documents, serves the opposite direction: assessing your own vendors. The Trust Center, which lets prospects self-serve documents, is an adjacent feature and earns no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a sales lead, security questionnaires get answered by AI from my actual controls and knowledge base — drafts I review, not blank spreadsheets I fill
